job.job_description:
We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to design, develop and deploy production-grade Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions.




Required skills:

Strong proficiency in Python, SQL and REST APIs
Hands-on experience with Machine Learning, Deep Learning and model evaluation
Experience with Scikit-learn and TensorFlow or PyTorch
Practical experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG and vector databases
Experience building AI agents using LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen or similar frameworks
Knowledge of tool/function calling, multi-step workflows, state/memory management and human-in-the-loop patterns
Experience integrating agents with APIs, databases and enterprise applications



Preferred:

Experience with multi-agent systems and agent orchestration
Knowledge of MCP and enterprise search
Banking, financial services or healthcare domain experience



Location: Gurgaon [Onsite]




Interested candidates can share their resumes at megha.goyal@devlabstechnology.com
